tasks.description: Add an 'Export to CSV' button on the sales report page that initiates a download of the currently displayed report when clicked. The button should be accessible and follow the product's design guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the 'Export to CSV' button is clicked, then a CSV download is initiated.

tasks.description: Develop a backend endpoint that generates the CSV for the requested report and streams the response to the client, ensuring memory usage stays bounded regardless of report size.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large sales report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without significant memory usage increase.

tasks.description: Implement a feature that allows users to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the column selection feature, when a user selects specific columns, then the generated CSV includes only those columns in the correct order.

tasks.description: Encode the CSV per RFC 4180: quote fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escape embedded double quotes by doubling them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CSV export, when the file is opened in a spreadsheet application, then the data is correctly formatted and escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: Ensure the first row of the CSV contains the human-readable column names for the selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CSV export, when the file is opened, then the first row contains the correct human-readable column names.

tasks.description: Connect the 'Export to CSV' button with the streaming export endpoint, ensuring that the correct report data is exported based on user selections.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page, when the 'Export to CSV' button is clicked with specific column selections, then the correct CSV data is downloaded.
